entities.summary: Carlos Garaikoetxea Urriza is a Basque former politician from Spain who served as Lehendakari (president) of the Basque Autonomous Community from 1979 to 1985. He was the second person to be elected to the office after José Antonio Aguirre, who held the position from 1936 to 1960.
